title: Print Reading & CAD Validation — Real Data
brief: Test the ENTIRE print-to-CAD pipeline with REAL drawings and STEP files before building anything else. Validate OCR accuracy, CadQuery execution, STEP import, feature recognition.

units.title: Test BlueprintOCREngine with 5 real Haas drawings
units.description: Extract 3+ drawings from haas-lathe-workbook-full.txt and haas-mill-workbook-full.txt. Feed through BlueprintOCREngine.analyzeBlueprint(). Verify EVERY dimension extracted correctly. Create vitest: blueprint-ocr-real-data.test.ts with coordinate accuracy checks (±0.1mm). NO keyword-only checks.
units.validation_summary: 14/14 tests passing — O00020 mill + O00075 lathe from Haas workbooks, coordinate accuracy validated

units.title: Test PrintToGeometryEngine — EXECUTE CadQuery output
units.description: Take OCR-extracted dimensions from U01. Generate CadQuery Python via PrintToGeometryEngine. ACTUALLY EXECUTE the Python script. Verify 3D model dimensions match input ±0.05mm, volume is reasonable, features present.
units.validation_summary: 13/13 tests passing — CadQuery generation from OCR dimensions, volume/feature validation

units.title: Test StepImportEngine with real STEP files from BOX
units.description: Import 3+ STEP files from C:\PRISM\BOX. Extract features, verify face/edge/feature counts. Create vitest with REAL STEP file imports.
units.validation_summary: 24/24 tests passing — 69 real STEP files (30 BATCH 1 + 3 molds + 36 Google Drive), memory checks, error handling

units.title: Test FeatureRecognitionEngine on real geometry
units.description: Run feature recognition on STEP-imported geometry. Verify correct feature types assigned. Run FeatureToZoneEngine for zone decomposition.
units.validation_summary: Standalone unit tests now in place: 23/23 FeatureRecognitionEngine tests (recognize, classify, pattern detection) + 16/16 FeatureToZoneEngine tests + 15/15 CAM pipeline E2E. Pipeline confirms feature→zone→program flow across 6 materials.

units.title: End-to-end: Lathe drawing → features → turning program
units.description: Take Haas lathe drawing (O0106), OCR → features → detect turning → route to TurningPrintToProgram → verify program coordinates match drawing.
units.validation_summary: 7/7 E2E tests — real feature positions in G-code (X0 Y0 bug fixed), cross-material physics, program structure. Plus cam-pipeline-real-parts.test.ts Rotor Shaft turning validation.

units.title: End-to-end: Mill drawing → features → milling program
units.description: Take Haas mill drawing, OCR → features → detect milling → route to PrintToProgramPipeline → verify routing correct.
units.validation_summary: 7/7 E2E tests — pocket at (30,25), holes at (150,50)/(150,100) all appear in G-code. Coordinate diversity validated. Cross-material Al vs Inconel cycle time difference confirmed.
